Japan's **Anthropic Usage Index is 1.91** (data period starting 2026-05-01). It ranks **32nd of 121** countries.

The index takes a country's share of Claude usage and divides it by its share of the world's working-age population. A value of 1.0 is the global average, so Japan's Claude usage is about 91% higher than its population alone would predict.

Some other figures for Japan, compared with the global average:
- **Why people use Claude:** 47% work (global 43%), 47% personal (global 40%) and 6% coursework (global 16%).
- **How people use Claude:** 53% augmentation, where Claude helps the person do the work (global 51%). 47% automation, where Claude does the work (global 49%).

Source and methodology: https://www.anthropic.com/economic-index
